methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series A → next-stage step-up multiplier (2.0x) to $22M total raised proxy.

data.narrative:
Pipedream is a Series A infrastructure and logistics company founded by Garrett McCurrach and Canon Reeves. The company has raised $22.4M to date. No direct public comparables or recent private peer transactions were identified within the infrastructure and logistics sector to inform valuation.

The valuation analysis employs stage-progression methodology, using total capital raised as a proxy for current embedded value. Applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $22.4M raised base yields an implied valuation of $44.8M. This represents a standard dilutive progression assumption between early and growth-stage funding rounds.

The analysis triangulates to a median valuation of $45M, with a range of $38M to $52M reflecting reasonable variance around the stage-progression estimate. The single-method approach and absence of comparable company data represent material limitations. Key uncertainties include unit economics, revenue traction, capital efficiency relative to peers (unmeasured due to comp absence), and market conditions affecting Series A deployment multiples. Any valuation within the $38M–$52M band should be treated as preliminary pending deeper operational and market analysis.
